description: This Java source file defines the class `JuelConnector`, which acts as a facade to connect the OFBiz framework with the JUEL (Java Unified Expression Language) library. It includes modifications to enable auto-vivify behavior (automatic creation of list or map structures during assignment) in expression evaluation. The class provides methods to create customized ExpressionFactory instances and introduces extended AST node classes and parser logic to support auto-vivifying expressions.

classes.name: JuelConnector
classes.description: A facade class used to connect the OFBiz framework to the JUEL library, with modifications for auto-vivifying expressions.

methods.description: Returns a customized ExpressionFactory instance that supports auto-vivify.

classes.description: A custom parser class that handles auto-vivify expressions during parsing.
